crags.name: Index Town Wall
crags.notes: Granite dries fast. Lower Wall sheds water quickly; Upper Wall slower after heavy rain.

crags.name: Leavenworth
crags.notes: Rain shadow effect — dries significantly faster than west-side crags. Icicle Canyon blocks moisture.

crags.name: Vantage
crags.notes: Desert climate, basalt dries fast. Wind is a major factor — often climbable when west-side crags are soaked.

crags.name: Little Si
crags.notes: Wetter microclimate than Index. Higher humidity typical. Needs more drying time.

crags.name: Mt. Erie
crags.notes: Island climate — high humidity, slow drying. Needs 48h+ after rain to be reliable.

crags.name: Peshastin Pinnacles
crags.notes: Sandstone — NEVER climb when wet. Holds water in pockets, damages rock when damp. Needs 48-72h after rain.
